name: dumbbell-stiff-leg-deadlift.html
instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing your body.
2. Engage your core, keep your chest up, and your shoulders back. This is the starting position.
3. Push your hips back, not down, while slightly bending your knees. Lower the dumbbells along the front of your legs.
4. Continue hinging until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings (usually when the dumbbells reach mid-shin or slightly below.)
5. Reverse the motion by driving your hips forward, bringing your torso back up while maintaining a straight back. This is one rep.
6. Perform the desired reps, focusing on controlled movements and proper form.
